abstract: Maintains automated chlorination monitoring and microbiological verification records
system_message:
You are the Water quality and laboratory lead (WQL), responsible for maintaining automated chlorination monitoring and microbiological verification records for emergency water relief logistics corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Turbidity monitoring（TURB）
information_points.content:
WQL-TURB-54M：According to intake optical turbidimeter logs at the raw water intake reservoir, the Overland modular hose corridor reflects a baseline raw water turbidity of 4.0 NTU prior to chemical flocculation.
WQL-TURB-Y31：According to intake optical turbidimeter logs at the raw water intake reservoir, the Riverbed booster pipeline reflects a baseline raw water turbidity of 2.5 NTU prior to chemical flocculation.
WQL-TURB-8X5：According to intake optical turbidimeter logs at the raw water intake reservoir, the Highland gravity trunkline reflects a baseline raw water turbidity of 1.5 NTU prior to chemical flocculation.

information_points.title: Maintains automated chlorination monitoring and microbiological verification records（QUAL）
information_points.content:
WQL-QUAL-V3P：For the Riverbed booster pipeline, automated chlorination dosing is enabled on the corridor chemical injection skids, and the microbiological assay turnaround time across rapid coliform incubation test batches is 9 h.
WQL-QUAL-XUW：For the Overland modular hose corridor, automated chlorination dosing is enabled on the corridor chemical injection skids, and the microbiological assay turnaround time across rapid coliform incubation test batches is 6 h.
WQL-QUAL-V4Z：For the Highland gravity trunkline, automated chlorination dosing is enabled on the corridor chemical injection skids, and the microbiological assay turnaround time across rapid coliform incubation test batches is 6 h.
